about: OH image index (Lane D2): sku -> the image entry in MANIFEST.json, so public/oh/products.json can stay the crawl's data and a page resolves its image by sku. src is the path to render: the WebP (transparent) when the defect check accepted the file, otherwise the generated placeholder. webp and png are transparent, jpg is on white; all are size x size. found says where the image URL came from: taxonomy-link (the crawl's image link) or product-page (the product page's server data). large, on the products the campaign art places, is the same image at 840 x 840 (webp, png, jpg as above), for art and full-size heroes; a page that wants the large rendition asks for products[sku].large and falls back to src. Provenance per file is in MANIFEST.json (sections products and large).
